Pinned files downloaded verbatim from raw.githubusercontent.com:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ColinLeung-NiloCat/UnityURPToonLitShaderExample/fbe276e0df1d1f9379e13581c20b6a080a1a6977/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ColinLeung-NiloCat/UnityURPToonLitShaderExample/fbe276e0df1d1f9379e13581c20b6a080a1a6977/SimpleURPToonLitOutlineExample_LightingEquation.hlsl
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ColinLeung-NiloCat/UnityURPToonLitShaderExample/fbe276e0df1d1f9379e13581c20b6a080a1a6977/SimpleURPToonLitOutlineExample_Shared.hlsl

Original HLSL files are stored with .txt extensions as reference sources to avoid
importing the original example shader or conflicting with project shader names.

Adaptation in ../../Shaders/RetroToonForward.hlsl:
- ShadeSingleLight's smoothstep(N dot L) cel band and shadow-map attenuation.
- ShadeGI's constant ambient spherical-harmonic term.
- CompositeAllLightResults' maximum of ambient and direct light.
- A compact shared UnityPerMaterial layout, matching the example's architecture.

Project changes: simplified opaque material, adjustable texture influence, explicit
shadow tint strength, current URP 17 shadow coordinate handling and official URP
ShadowCaster/DepthOnly/DepthNormals passes. Outlines are a separate fullscreen
renderer feature. This project uses only the public MIT example, not NiloToonURP.
